title: Map labelling #9
topic: university campus · museum · sports centre · holiday village
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The university campus.
Guide: Welcome to the university campus. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the library. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the art studio is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the student union is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The language lab is directly behind the library, at the back of the site.
Guide: The bike shed is right next to the language lab, on its right side.
Guide: The health centre is right next to the bike shed, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The museum.
Guide: Welcome to the museum. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the dinosaur hall is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the cafeteria is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the cloakroom. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: The gift counter is directly behind the cloakroom, at the back of the site.
Guide: The archive room is directly behind the cafeteria, at the back of the site.
Guide: The costume gallery is in the middle at the back, between the gift counter and the archive room.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The sports centre.
Guide: Welcome to the sports centre. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the juice bar. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the dance studio. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the physio room. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: The squash courts is directly behind the juice bar, at the back of the site.
Guide: The weights room is directly behind the physio room, at the back of the site.
Guide: The reception is directly behind the dance studio, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The holiday village.
Guide: Welcome to the holiday village. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the games room is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the campfire circle. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the bike hire. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: The nature trail office is directly behind the bike hire, at the back of the site.
Guide: The shop is directly behind the campfire circle, at the back of the site.
Guide: The restaurant is directly behind the games room, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
